## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Materials showing leadership (C, JPM, FCX ABOVE TREND) while Tech is mixed with strong winners but several short-term recoveries, indicating money is rotating rather than fleeing; Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5, Materials 1/5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +22.97%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak overall (sector negative this week). Consumer Staples mixed to weak: PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5, Materials 1/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select consumer names and pocketed healthcare stress.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; watch AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY for reversal risk and ORCL for news divergence.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but influential: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND show momentum while ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with negative headlines, and AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY suggests rotation within the group; Sector is one of the positive contributors this week.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials broad leadership: JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND and SCHW (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND point to sustained cyclical support; sector is a primary confirmation of the ROTATION regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND provide support while MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.46%) CORRECTION signal select defensive pressure; breadth within healthcare is uneven.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Materials exposure given leadership (C, JPM, FCX ABOVE TREND) and monitor Tech winners for sustainability; reduce exposure to lagging consumer staples/discretionary names showing BELOW TREND or CORRECTION. Style: mixed with a Value/Cyclical tilt while watching narrow Tech concentration for potential broadening or quick reversal.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (sector leading this week), Financials (broad strength), Technology (key winners driving flows) — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary, Utilities, Consumer Staples where several names are in CORRECTION/BEOLOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND — sustain weekly gains to confirm continuation; ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through after big weekly move given negative news flow; C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND — hold monthly trend to keep Financial leadership intact; FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND — watch for profit-taking signals that would blunt Materials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (+50): XOM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND — news on lifted 2030 outlook confirms price action. C (+50): C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND — regulatory relief/asset sale headlines confirm the rally. PFE (+50): PFE (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -2.45%) RECOVERY — bullish headlines present but price shows short-term divergence so watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-45): ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines on AI spending clash with strong price, a classic divergence to monitor. BA (-50): BA (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND — sanctions headlines conflict with strong trend, watch for catalyst-driven pullbacks. KHC (-45): KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND — negative commentary confirms weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (Tech-heavy top performers) and headline divergences on ORCL and BA that could sap momentum — monitor sentiment and follow-through.
